home-2: Heer ya can find listz of 3DS an DS homebrew, upd8d regularly ta make sure yer gettin da latest versionz. Click da linkz in da navigashun bar at da top ta get full listz, or check out sum of da most recently upd8d at da bottom of dis page!
home-3: Most informashun on dis site iz automaticallee gatherd frum da informashun on da app's GitHub repository, however if ya notice any incorrect informashun plz report it as a GitHub Issue or on our Discord server. Tankz!
home-4: Dis iz also possible ta add ta Universal-Updater, so if ya'd like ta browse an install appz frum Atlas + Universal-DB directly on yer 3DS ya shud give it a try.
home-5: On da Nintendo DSi dere are two optionz fer downloadin appz frum Atlas + Universal-DB. dsidl can use da QR codez on da site or Kekatsu which functionz fully on device. If ya hab not used Kekatsu before, place dis databases.txt in sd:/Kekatsu/.
home-6: Want ta be notified of new updatez ta homebrew? We hab an RSS feed on dis site, just copy dis page's URL into yer favorite RSS reader. Da RSS feed iz also syndicated into our Discord server's #universal-db-updates an ta our Bluesky!
